basics.name: Suraj S
basics.about: Full-stack developer at Taabi Mobility, where I've spent the last two years building backend systems for a vehicle telematics platform — covering video telematics, fleet safety, payment services, and driver monitoring. I work mostly on the backend: Node.js/GraphQL microservices, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB for time-series-heavy fleet data, Redis, and Kafka, with a focus on data pipelines, alerting systems, and dashboards that fleet safety teams rely on daily. Recognized as Employee of the Quarter for my work there. I bring the same full-stack range from earlier stints in database engineering and software engineering, and enjoy collaborative environments that reward curiosity and ownership.

projects.title: Driver Behavior Intelligence Engine
projects.description: A Kafka-driven, Redis-backed engine that detects and clusters prolonged unsafe driving behavior across a fleet in near real time. Computes a weighted risk score per driver/vehicle with configurable priority across vehicle, customer, and global levels, persists clusters to PostgreSQL, and exposes results via GraphQL. Includes a live terminal dashboard for monitoring the pipeline.

projects.title: EV Telematics Analytics Service
projects.description: A new Node.js/Apollo GraphQL microservice built to serve analytics for electric vehicle telematics data, extending the platform's existing fleet analytics to EVs.

projects.title: Granular Safety Alerting for ADAS/DMS
projects.description: Redesigned a generic 'inactive vehicle' alert into two granular alerts — one for missing Driver Monitoring System signals (camera blocked, seatbelt, fatigue, distraction) and one for missing ADAS signals (forward collision, lane departure, pedestrian detection, following distance) — giving fleet safety teams more actionable alerts without new schema.

projects.title: Cross-System Data Validation Framework
projects.description: A configurable tool that compares Azure Parquet exports against live PostgreSQL tables to catch data drift and sync failures. Refactored into a multi-table, config-driven framework with a resilient auto-reconnecting Postgres client and parallel range-download support for large blobs; used to trace recurring data validation failures back to late-arriving telemetry.

projects.title: Git Promotion CLI
projects.description: A CLI that automates promoting code through SIT → UAT → PROD branches, with JIRA integration, automatic commit categorization, and merge conflict prediction. Includes an opt-in AI-assisted PR description generator and a companion script that reconstructs commit history reachable only from the SIT branch.

projects.title: kubectlNav
projects.description: A Tkinter-based desktop tool for browsing Kubernetes logs — split-pane dashboard with a pod status sidebar and a multi-threaded architecture to keep log streaming responsive.
